tools.name: pa_extract_lfb1
tools.description: Extract SAP LFB1 (CC-level vendor master) into pa_<user>.lfb1 (replace mode). bukrs required. Returns all extended vendors incl. legacy / blocked / one-time accounts (typical CC1000 = several thousand rows). Carries the per-CC payment block (ZAHLS — the field that the 2026-05-27 Proximus diagnosis pinpointed), reconciliation account, allowed payment methods, dunning procedure, and CC-level posting block. pa_vendor_aging's effective_payment_block joins LFB1.ZAHLS when staged.

inputSchema.description:
pa_extract_lfb1 — LFB1 (CC-level vendor master). `bukrs` required scope.

Carries the per-company-code vendor settings that aren't on LFA1:
payment block (ZAHLS — the field that the 2026-05-27 Proximus
diagnosis pinpointed as the missing source of truth), reconciliation
account (AKONT), allowed payment methods (ZWELS), default payment
terms (ZTERM), dunning procedure (MAHNV), CC-level posting block
(SPERR — distinct from LFA1.SPERR, which is cross-CC).

LFA1 is the global vendor master (one row per vendor); LFB1 is the
per-CC overlay (one row per vendor per CC). Both must be staged for
the full picture; pa_vendor_aging's effective_payment_block joins
LFB1 when present.
inputSchema.title: ExtractLfb1Args

tools.description: Per-currency intercompany reconciliation between two entities: A's open AR to B (BSID where bukrs=bukrs_a) vs B's open AP to A (BSIK where bukrs=bukrs_b). pa_reconcile_intercompany — B6 (v0.0.110). For two intercompany
entities A and B, reconciles per currency:
  - A's open AR to B: BSID rows in A's books posted to B's IC KUNNRs
  - B's open AP to A: BSIK rows in B's books posted to A's IC LIFNRs

  bukrs_a / bukrs_b
    SAP company codes — the books we're reading. Required.

There are TWO ways to specify which counterparty numbers belong to
each side. Supply EXACTLY one pairing mode:

    IC-registry group_labels identifying each entity's LIFNR/KUNNR
    set. Must be distinct. group_label is the entity identity column
    on `pa_common.intercompany_lifnrs` / `_kunnrs`; the F12
    entity-orchestrator (`pa_admin_register_ic_entity`) is the typical
    registration path. NOTE (I-09): in production the seeded registry
    rows carry an empty group_label, so this mode can't address a
    single entity pair until the registry is curated — use mode (2)
    meanwhile.

    The IC counterparty numbers for each side, supplied directly:
    `a_lifnrs` = A's vendor (LIFNR) numbers as they appear in B's
    books; `b_kunnrs` = B's customer (KUNNR) numbers as they appear

    wrong (I-09). Robust to a broken registry; the analyst owns
    correctness of the numbers.

pipeline_snapshots for the pipeline_* views). `view` picks the shape;
`metric` selects the metric/bucket roll-up; on `daily_trend` the metric
is one of ap_total | ar_total | ap_overdue | ar_overdue and the side
is inferred from the metric prefix. On pipeline_history the metric is
one of open_pr_value | open_po_gross | open_po_residual; on
pipeline_trajectory the metric arg is ignored (all three are returned).
inputSchema.title: SnapshotSeriesArgs

tools.name: pa_snapshot_diff
tools.description: Diff the latest snapshots at-or-before from_date and to_date. Categorises (bukrs, counterparty, waers) pairs as new (only in to-snapshot), cleared (only in from), or changed_amount (delta != 0). top_n caps each category.

inputSchema.description:
pa_snapshot_diff — diff the two latest snapshots at-or-before from_date
and to_date. Categorises (bukrs, counterparty, waers) pairs as new /
cleared / changed_amount.
inputSchema.title: SnapshotDiffArgs

tools.name: pa_overdue_concentration
tools.description: Top-N counterparties by absolute overdue amount, per currency. side='ap' uses BSIK + LFA1; side='ar' uses BSID + KNA1. Reports each counterparty's open and overdue amounts plus the share of the per-currency overdue total.

inputSchema.description:
pa_overdue_concentration — top-N counterparties by abs(overdue_amt) per
currency. side='ap' reads BSIK + LFA1; side='ar' reads BSID + KNA1.
inputSchema.title: OverdueConcentrationArgs

tools.name: pa_collections_worklist
tools.description: Behaviour-aware ranked AR collections worklist for one company code (per currency). Composes BSID overdue exposure with each customer's BSAD historical days-to-pay, their dunning level, and a transparent priority score that ranks a customer whose payment behaviour has slipped above one who is reliably-but-predictably slow. All score components are exposed; intercompany excluded by default.

inputSchema.description:
pa_collections_worklist (AR4) — behaviour-aware ranked AR collections
list for one company code. Reads BSID (open AR) + BSAD (cleared history)
+ KNA1 (names). AR-only (no side arg).
inputSchema.title: CollectionsWorklistArgs

tools.name: pa_aging_histogram
tools.description: Histogram of open or cleared items by date field at a chosen granularity. side x state picks the source table (bsik/bsid/bsak/bsad); field is one of BLDAT|BUDAT|ZFBDT|AUGDT|NET_DUE_DATE; granularity is day|week|month|quarter|year. Replaces the v1 histogram_by arg cluster.

inputSchema.description:
pa_aging_histogram — histogram of open or cleared items by some date
field at a chosen granularity. Replaces the v1 histogram_by arg cluster.
inputSchema.title: AgingHistogramArgs

tools.name: sap_material_costs
tools.description: Live SAP unit costs (MBEW) for a list of Windchill part numbers, in one batched read. Windchill part N -> SAP MATNR N/<rev>; returns {costs:{N:{unit_cost,matnr,price_basis,peinh}}, currency, plant, stats}. Used by rd-mcp windchill_bom_cost. Optional plant (BWKEY, default 1100). Read-only.
